# prreviewer

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-bots/internal/pr-reviewer"
```

Package pr\-reviewer reviews pull requests against the repository's pull request template and issue templates, posting review comments in the style of PR Agent.

Review reads a pull request's diff, the repository's PULL\_REQUEST\_TEMPLATE.md and issue templates, checks the PR body against the template checklist, flags common issues \(hardcoded secrets, large files, missing tests, ...\), and posts a review comment on the pull request plus per\-file comments.

It labels the pull request with its area \(from the files it touches\) and its type \(from its title or branch name, when they follow Conventional Commits\).

type ReviewAPI interface {

<a name="ReviewResult"></a>
## type ReviewResult

ReviewResult is the outcome of a Review.

```go
type ReviewResult struct {
    // PR is the pull request that was reviewed.
    PR  int
    // Title is the pull request title.
    Title string
    // Base and Head are the pull request's base and head branches.
    Base, Head string
    // Files are the files changed in the pull request.
    Files []FileReview
    // Summary is a one-paragraph assessment of the pull request.
    Summary string
    // Checklist is the template checklist with each item marked done or not.
    Checklist []ChecklistItem
    // Issues are problems found in the diff (severity, message).
    Issues []Issue
    // Labels are the labels applied to the pull request.
    Labels []string
    // Comment is the review comment posted on the pull request.
    Comment string
}
```

<a name="Review"></a>
### func Review

```go
func Review(ctx context.Context, api ReviewAPI, opts ReviewOptions) (*ReviewResult, error)
```

Review reviews pull request pr. It fetches the pull request, its changed files, and the repository's pull request and issue templates, then posts a review comment and labels. A dry run makes no changes.
